title: a focus timer web app
pitch: A Pomodoro-style focus timer in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript: no frameworks, no build step.

steps.title: Layout and styling
steps.goal: Show a 25:00 timer, a label and Start / Reset buttons, centred, dark theme.
steps.why: Get the layout right first, so the logic later has stable element ids to hook into.

steps.title: Countdown logic
steps.goal: Start/pause toggles a countdown that updates once per second; Reset returns to 25:00.
steps.why: The timer measures elapsed time against a start timestamp instead of counting ticks, so it stays accurate when the browser throttles background tabs.

steps.title: Progress ring, sessions and shortcuts
steps.goal: Add an SVG progress ring, a completed-session counter saved in localStorage and a Space-bar shortcut.
steps.why: A ring shows progress at a glance, and the keyboard shortcut means you never need the mouse while focusing.
